newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn mostly steady, soy mixed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn mostly steady, soy mixed.

text.p: FOB Gulf corn basis values were steady to lower on Monday while soybean positions were mixed amid a lack of farm movement and slow export activity, dealers said.
Hard red winter wheat offers rose two cents a bushel.

In export news, Pakistan bought 225,000 tonnes U.S. soft white wheat over the weekend in an approximate range of $169.60 to $171.22 a tonne FOB, U.S. exporters said. Shipment was slated for October 10-31, they said.

Also, Surinam bought 2,800 tonnes U.S. northern spring/dark northern spring wheat under PL 480 export program on September 27, USDA said. Shipment was set for October 10-25. The wheat was acquired from Cargill Inc at $186.09 a tonne, FOB U.S. Gulf.
